title: The Crossroads
intro: Travelers whisper that something beneath the old country roads is waking. Begin at the crossroads, follow the signs, and see what the buried vault has forgotten.
mapText: Map: [Tavern]-Crossroads-[Woods]-[Ruins]-[Crypt]; Crossroads north to Old Road and south to Riverbank; Woods north to Clearing, then east to Cave and down to its Vault; Shrine links Old Road and Riverbank.

crossroads.name: The Crossroads
crossroads.description: A weathered signpost points toward several equally questionable adventures.

bent_coin.name: The Bent Coin
bent_coin.description: A warm, noisy tavern where the stew is cheap and the chairs are mostly intact.

old_road.name: The Old Road
old_road.description: Broken milestones vanish into weeds beneath a sky full of circling crows.

whispering_woods.name: The Whispering Woods
whispering_woods.description: The branches murmur whenever the wind stops, which seems deeply unfair.

mossy_clearing.name: The Mossy Clearing
mossy_clearing.description: Pale mushrooms ring a moss-covered stone and something watches from the brush.

cave_mouth.name: The Cave Mouth
cave_mouth.description: Cold air rises from a stair cut into the rock. Tiny footprints lead downward.

echoing_cave.name: The Echoing Cave
echoing_cave.description: Water ticks into black pools. Every sound returns with one extra footstep.

buried_vault.name: The Buried Vault
buried_vault.description: An ancient iron door hangs open before a chamber full of dust and old bones.

ruins.name: The Fallen Ruins
ruins.description: Roofless halls surround a dry fountain carved with forgotten names.

crypt.name: The Sunken Crypt
crypt.description: Cracked statues stand guard over stairs that descend into greenish mist.

riverbank.name: The Moonlit Riverbank
riverbank.description: A fast river cuts through reeds and smooth black stones.

hilltop_shrine.name: The Hilltop Shrine
hilltop_shrine.description: Blue candles burn without wind beneath the calm gaze of a stone traveler.

wraith.name: vault wraith
wraith.encounterText: The candles die as the vault's last guardian peels itself from the wall.
wraith.victoryText: The wraith dissolves, and a sealed lantern at the center of the vault burns blue for the first time in centuries.
